# MCC Solutions LLC

> Licensed mobile notary, NNA certified loan signing agent, and QuickBooks ProAdvisor Gold bookkeeping firm based in Cranford, New Jersey, serving Central New Jersey. Founded by Matthew Coleman in 2025.

MCC Solutions LLC provides three core services: mobile notary and NNA certified loan signing (in person across Central NJ or remote online notarization nationwide), QuickBooks ProAdvisor Gold certified small business bookkeeping, and custom hand-built websites with local SEO.

## Company facts

- Legal name: MCC Solutions LLC
- Founder / Owner: Matthew Coleman
- Founded: 2025
- Location: Cranford, New Jersey, 07016
- Phone / text: (908) 444-6373
- Email: matthewc@mcc-solutionsnj.com
- Website: https://mcc-solutionsnj.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 6PM–9PM, Saturday–Sunday 9AM–8PM
- Service area: Central New Jersey — Union, Middlesex, Somerset, Mercer, Monmouth, and Hunterdon Counties. Remote online notarization and bookkeeping available nationwide.
- Credentials: NNA Certified Loan Signing Agent, QuickBooks ProAdvisor Gold (Level 1, Level 2, Payroll), active New Jersey Notary Public Commission, FINRA SIE & Series 30 licenses, $100,000 Errors & Omissions insurance, B.S.B.A. Accounting & Finance (Kutztown University).
- Pricing model: Custom quotes for every engagement — please inquire. Loan signing appointments are booked at a flat rate; travel fees are confirmed at booking.

## Services

- [Mobile Notary & Loan Signing](https://mcc-solutionsnj.com/#services): General notarization, power of attorney, healthcare directives, real estate closings, and mortgage loan signings. Same-day appointments available evenings and weekends. Remote online notarization (RON) available nationwide.
- [Bookkeeping](https://mcc-solutionsnj.com/#services): Monthly bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online setup and cleanup, financial reporting, accounts payable/receivable, payroll processing, and year-end tax-ready preparation.
- [Website & Digital Solutions](https://mcc-solutionsnj.com/#services): Custom hand-built websites (no templates) with full local SEO, schema markup, and ongoing maintenance.
